notes: Before: Go 1.25.0 pre-built binary (has CrossOriginProtection but without userinfo check)
After: Go built from patched worktree source (commit 2a95a616e9da) with Go 1.25.0 bootstrap
Coverage collected via go test -coverprofile on net/http package with -run TestCrossOriginProtectionAddTrustedOriginErrors

entries.expected_signal: userinfo origins (https://@example.com, https://user:pass@example.com) rejected in after build, accepted in before build
entries.reachability_signal: before: userinfo origins accepted (nil error); after: userinfo origins rejected with 'userinfo, path, query, and fragment are not allowed' error

contracts.detail: Userinfo origins (https://@example.com, https://user:pass@example.com, https://user@example.com) were accepted before patch (nil error) but rejected after patch. This is the intended compatibility change — input contract tightened to reject origins with userinfo parts.
Valid origins without userinfo (https://example.com, https://example.com:8080, http://example.com) are accepted by both before and after versions.

Origins with path/query/fragment/missing-scheme/missing-host are rejected by both versions. Note: error message text changed from 'path, query, and fragment are not allowed' to 'userinfo, path, query, and fragment are not allowed'.

coverage.details: csrf.go:68.2,68.75 count=1 (new u.User check), csrf.go:69.3,70.1 count=1 (new error return). AddTrustedOrigin function 100% covered.

behavior_differences.after: AddTrustedOrigin("https://@example.com") = error: invalid origin "https://@example.com": userinfo, path, query, and fragment are not allowed
behavior_differences.evidence: before_output.txt and after_output.txt show rejection change for 3 userinfo test cases

behavior_differences.before: invalid origin "https://example.com/": path, query, and fragment are not allowed
behavior_differences.after: invalid origin "https://example.com/": userinfo, path, query, and fragment are not allowed
behavior_differences.evidence: Error message text changed for path/query/fragment rejection cases — 'userinfo' added to error description

notes: Confirmed INPUT_CONTRACT_CHANGE: origins with userinfo now rejected. Browsers never send userinfo in Origin headers per RFC 6454, so practical impact is limited to programmatic callers.
Secondary ERROR_EXCEPTION_CHANGE: error message text changed for already-rejected inputs. Low practical impact.
Coverage: 100% of patched lines reached. Both new lines (68, 69) are executed during test.

conclusion.rationale: 补丁在 CrossOriginProtection.AddTrustedOrigin 中新增了对 userinfo 部分的检查，导致之前被接受的含 userinfo 的 origin 现在被拒绝。虽然浏览器不会发送含 userinfo 的 Origin 头（RFC 6454），但通过代码直接调用此 API 的调用方行为发生改变。补丁行覆盖率 100%，确认兼容性变更存在且被测试覆盖。错误消息文本也发生了变化（增加了 'userinfo' 字样），但影响较小。
recommended_actions: 审查所有调用 AddTrustedOrigin 的代码，确认是否传入了含 userinfo 的 origin 字符串
如有代码依赖旧的错误消息文本（'path, query, and fragment are not allowed'），需更新到新文本（'userinfo, path, query, and fragment are not allowed'）
此变更为安全加固，建议尽快合并
